Lina Morales: Follow-up from the 'prune & slab' RFC — proposal for a staged service-pruning playbook. goal: surgically remove one large legacy slab without surprise customer regressions. want guardrails + checklist. feedback?

Ethan Brooks: Important we map incidental dependencies first. last time we cut a slab and found 3 downstream cronjobs that assumed side effects.

Vikram Iyer: +1. propose a dependency discovery pass: static import scan + runtime tracing during a 48h observation window. mark weak vs hard dependencies.

Grace Park: Also add a 'behavioural contract' test set (smoke prompts + sampled production traces) to catch semantic regressions. not just request/response shape.

Lina Morales: Agreed. Draft high-level playbook:
1) Discovery: static + runtime dependency map (48h).
2) Contract freeze: 72h before first cut.
3) Adapter shim: thin facade to emulate removed slab where needed.
4) Staged cut: staging pilot -> internal pilot -> 1% public -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. soak at each step.
5) Telemetry: per-route p95/p99, error-rate, and semantic-quality delta from smoke prompts.
6) DB & derived state: snapshot -> backfill plan -> per-tenant ownership flips (avoid global dual-write).
7) Rollback: route flip + re-enable adapter + cache rehydrate. TTL for adapter retention: 14d soft, 60d archive.
8) Paydown ledger: track technical debt $hours saved vs migration cost; post-mortem after 30d.

Ethan Brooks: On discovery: include owner tags for all services and infra (who to call). add quick contact list to the runbook.

Vikram Iyer: For adapter shim we should limit scope: only surface APIs observed in the 30d traffic window. do not try to emulate obscure admin endpoints.

Grace Park: Telemetry gating thresholds suggestion: pause ramp if error_rate delta > 0.8% for 15m OR semantic-quality delta > 1% for 30m OR token-cost delta > 18% for 1h. escalate to owners.

Lina Morales: Nice. I'll use those as defaults in the RFC addendum. Also adding a pre-warm stage: replay recent prefix keys into cache for 20-45m and run a synthetic load for 10m.

ci-bot: created ticket ARCH-9202: "prune-slab: discovery pass and pilot" https://tracker/ARCH-9202

Ethan Brooks: Ops note: adjust HPA expectations during soak and canary; small ramps can skew p99 due to cold KV misses. schedule a controlled traffic-shift window.

Vikram Iyer: DB nuance: if derived-state backfill is >12h, split into incremental checkpoints and migrate high-priority tenants first. document migration order.

Grace Park: Test harness plan: smoke prompt set + golden-response corpus. run diffs after each ramp stage and alert on quality regression. keep diffs per-tenant as well.

Lina Morales: Action items: Ethan (dependency discovery + owner map), Vikram (adapter spec + DB backfill plan), Grace (smoke harness + gating), I'll write the playbook and the paydown ledger template. Sync Monday 9am. If no objections we start discovery Tues. :thumbsup:

Ethan Brooks: ack, will start scan Tues.

Vikram Iyer: ack, prototyping adapter interface this week. estimate 6d spike.

Grace Park: ack, will surface corpus + dashboards by Fri.

Lina Morales: Closing thread. I'll post the RFC addendum with thresholds, runbook link, and the paydown ledger before EOD Mon.
